episodes.visual_note: First two starts visually similar; third has distinct pitched-down start. Sampled views show wall departure, stairs, exit approach. Full-frame semantic review remains pending.
episodes.review_method: All frames decoded/structural audit; complete trajectory time span visually inspected at six-frame intervals (0.25s), with final frame included. Not frame-perfect collision or exposure-time certification.
episodes.review_result: Wall-facing off-route start followed by purposeful reorientation, stair traversal and exit crossing; source handoff confirmed. No gross visual discontinuity observed in sampled trajectory. Leading human waiting is excluded from targets; raw clip preserved.
